periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/teardrop shape with a high length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward and anterior tapering, with the lowest point extending significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior curve profile at the interface of the dark band and white lower back.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band covering approximately 40% of the visible vertical torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, roughly equivalent to the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semicircular curvature at the apex of the ears.
